text:
Tess L: Who's in for a Saturday kickoff watch + tiny fantasy side-bet? thinking 6:30pm in the commons. chips/veggies sign-up? 
Marco R: Im in. $3 buy-in? winner gets the crown (and the last donut). :trophy:
Ivy N: Count me in. I'll bring carrots + hummus. also can we do a 1-question trivia for halftime?
Connor: $3 works. i'll bring a bag of those weird cinnamon chips no one admits to loving.
Jules: Trivia idea  which team had the longest punt return last season? loser does dish duty for a week.
Tess L: lol dish duty stakes accepted. @Snackbot can you confirm we have plates/cups?
Snackbot: Inventory OK  plates 18, cups 25, napkins 40. Recommend one extra roll of paper towels. Order placed for +1 roll. :robot_face:
Marco R: Poll: snack preference  react with :one: for Tortilla, :two: for Kettle, :three: for Veggies. I vote :three:.
Ivy N: Also mixing playlist. Add songs to the "Kickoff Mix" doc.
Connor: Lineup help quick question: should I start M. Evans or flex with K. Drake? need steady points vs boom potential.
Jules: Evans if you want floor, Drake if you need upside. Whats your matchup?
Connor: Playing @Marco R who likes to stack defenses. leaning Drake for a surprise.
Marco R: Im tempted to stack but might backfire. Ill take the donut money either way.
Tess L: Finalizing: commons at 6:30, $3 jar by the coffee machine, snacks as signed up, trivia at halftime with Jules hosting. See you all Saturday! :stadium:
